summary: Project terminal statuses to GitHub closed state

delivery.outcome: Regression evidence binds every Planfile terminal status to GitHub closed state while preserving open-state projections.
nonGoals: No new GitHub API behavior beyond the implementation already on main.
No credentials, live network calls, or issue mutation in tests.
No changes to receipt storage or label projection.

architecture.decision: Extend the canonical terminal status set with blocked and failed, then assert every terminal/open projection through an offline fake issue; retain unknown status as a no-op.
architecture.rollback: Revert the status-set extension and regression tests; prior status projection remains available.

validation.evidence: Offline fake issue asserts done, completed, failed, blocked, canceled and open mappings without network.
